title: Sticky Toffee Pudding
hookLine: British-inspired sticky toffee pudding with 14 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Preheat & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat the oven to 180C/160C Fan/Gas 4. Butter a wide shallow 1.7-litre/3-pint ovenproof dish. Keep {m52883_1}, {m52883_2}, {m52883_3}, and {m52883_4} prepped and measured within reach so each step comes together smoothly and evenly.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure butter first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: Put the butter, sugar, eggs, flour, baking powder, bicarbonate of soda and treacle into a mixing bowl. Beat using an electric handheld whisk for about 30 seconds or until combined. Pour in the milk gradually and whisk again until smooth. Pour into the prepared dish. Bake for 35–40 minutes or until well risen and springy in the centre. Incorporate {m52883_5}, {m52883_6}, {m52883_7}, {m52883_8}, {m52883_9}, {m52883_10}, {m52883_11}, {m52883_12}, {m52883_13}, and {m52883_14} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Simmer & Dissolve Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: To make the sauce, put all the ingredients into a saucepan and stir over a low heat until the sugar has dissolved and the butter has melted. Bring to the boil, stirring for a minute.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: To serve, pour half the sauce over the pudding in the baking dish. Serve with the cream or ice cream. Plate into 4 generous servings while the flavors and textures are at their peak, and store any leftovers covered.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Press plastic wrap directly onto the warm custard surface while chilling to prevent a skin from forming.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
